notes.title: Interlude Patch: Flip The Script
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Scribes! It's time for a flippin' new spell!

This update includes Unfold: a new Movement Spell, New Maps, A Tutorial Kit adjustment, and some light fixes!

We also shout out the new Community Mod Library - hardworking Scribes making their mark on the game! Check out the highlights below and keep an eye on the Roadmap in Vellum's main menu as we go. 


New Movement Spell - Unfold
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a5a37375b641d7abe825a5f3e2a90ad54426af74.gif"]

Mental gymnastics? Watch this!

Keep an eye on your foes as you soar backwards through the air with Unfold!

This acrobatic Movement Spell flings you out of danger, granting a brief moment of invulnerability, and offers many pages to build more style into your aerial feats!

Drop deadly mines, craft a winning floor routine, and perform some high-damage trick shots to style on your foes! 


New Maps
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/3029d285277d6cfb4fb2552f5902ee2459457104.jpg"]

Roots and shoots and roads...

Venture to fresh combat arenas: Sequoia and Outlook! Fight beneath the tall trees, making use of long-range cover for a forest fight to be remembered.

In Outlook, weave between pillars of an ancient structure - where do these old roads lead? Battle the Torn in a time-worn relic of elsewhere!

 
Spend Early, Spend Often - Tutorial Spell Changes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/19614c658a259af5c79f18998e931b200bc80ba4.jpg"]

Note: This will unlock Callback for all Scribes, while re-locking Swoop!

We're making some initial changes to the new player experience with adjustments to the Tutorial Chapter! 

The order of some elements has changed to give Scribes more time to understand the Signature Ink choice they make. Additionally, we're making Callback the new default Spender Spell! 

This gives new Scribes a more versatile starting spell set to take into their first Of Scribes and Torn run - Callback's area damage capabilities are a smoother compliment to Jot! 

 
Community - Mods and More!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ca043850a17e45e86434c10453b0c58a160ffbee.jpg"]Just a bit of tINKering...

There has been some awesome community work on Mods for Vellum! Pet the Inkling, pack more decoration into your Reading Nook, and more creative additions await! 

You can find these mods in the Discord Community Mods Library - a special thanks to the authors for your excitement and sharing your work!

 
Epilogue
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/9b6c070b5d585ffb1e675a5be2accc603edff872.jpg"]

The quiet calm of a book club!

Keep an eye out for Vellum in the Yogscast Small Teams fest currently on Steam! In other news, we're gearing up for the next Major Chapter - more info to come, with plenty to read.

Thank you to our testers, everyone in the discord, our newest mod-makers, and Scribes of all Ink Levels! 

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: "Spoilers"
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Scribes! With 1.1: Beyond now behind us, we look to new waters - beginning with a fresh new spell! 



-- Interlude Patch: "Spoilers" ahead... --



This update includes Spoil: a new Spender Spell, Visual Intensity Settings, Raid-Specific Spell Tuning, and several bug fixes, minor adjustments! Keep an eye out for some snazzy new Nook Items, too!

Check out the highlights below and, as always, you can track our journey from the Roadmap in Vellum's main menu. We also discuss our continuing Vellum plans at the end of this post! 


New Spender Spell - Spoil
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/16ffa559c7abe9523acca579c82564a250d5801f.gif"]

How 'bout them apples?

Brand new to the spellbook, Scribes get to live a fresh, ripe, totally-not-rotten fairytale fantasy with Spoil! 

"Offer" your foes a scrumptious bite of a Spoiled Apple and watch as they share their positive reviews with nearby pals! These Apples are tasty, healthy, and only get better with a hefty helping of Pages of Power!

Aim true while flinging bushel after bushel of this sticky, explosive 1-Cost Spender... and find out just how hungry the Torn really are.


Visual Intensity Settings
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8050a093ceadb6206fd5c597019823b10435b378.jpg"]

Details and details and details!

We're introducing Visual Intensity Settings based on your feedback! These new options allow you to further customize your experience for increased performance and legibility both solo and in multiplayer. 

In pursuit of these changes, our VFX system has had performance improvements across the board (even without using these new settings!). 

Player spells and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting.

Enemy abilities and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting.

There are a lot of visuals in Vellum - please let us know how your experience with these new settings goes!


Raid-Specific Spell Tuning and Balance
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a2b6a6dfee75b65e0fbd68d4c62b08e004ee6285.jpg"]

The flexible spellcraft of Scribes is a complex curriculum. Time to teach the Torn Lords a lesson or two.

With the rise of the Torn Lords, we've found (with the help of plenty of feedback!) the disparity between spell damage across the different loadout options in Raids is larger than we'd like! 

The lower number of pages available in Raids combined with the Boss/Single-Target heavy encounter profiles, has resulted in some spells falling behind in power/excitement. With Interlude Patch: Spoilers, we're pumping up the damage output of several spells when damaging Raid Bosses only. 

Foil, Punctuate, Enkindle, Quip, Blossom, Wordsmith, and Passage will now deal 20 - 66% increased damage to Raid Bosses (details in the patch notes below). Let us know how these feel!


Epilogue
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/cea9b5b888446e2f286fae829d201515c518cc84.jpg"]

Finding a cozy nook in the Illuminated Library to keep reading!

With The Grey Area, The Forgery, and Yonder now complete along with the Early Access journey - we're going to be adjusting our cadence of content! We're incredibly proud of the speed, quality, and quantity of Vellum's Major Chapters and Interlude Patches thus far... especially when we're operating as such a small team (if you're active in the Discord - you've likely heard from all of us directly by this point!)

Since EA launch, we typically added new content about every two weeks, alternating between Interludes and Major Chapters. Of course, some updates had adjusted timings for major life events and bigger-scope items (especially as the Library Update, Raids, and 1.0 approached). 

As a small team, we'll remain incredibly flexible (today's patch includes feedback from this morning - we love this!), but we'll be targeting a few more weeks between updates and more Interludes between Major Chapters. This new pace lets us stay reactive to feedback, continue to chase cool ideas, and gives us more time to plan what comes next!



Thank you for playing Vellum and joining us as the literary journey continues to unfold! Go read a book!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: In Circulation
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Scribes! It's been almost two weeks since 1.0 dropped and we've been blown away by the enthusiasm and support for Vellum. Thank you!

Today - we're channeling our own 1.0 excitement into Interlude Patch: In Circulation!

This update includes Circulate: a new Movement Spell, Performance and QOL Upgrades, Book Club Reward Updates, Vignette Secrets, an Ascendant Rewards Adjustment, Raid Tuning, Photosensitivity Mode and many bug fixes.

Check out the highlights of this patch below and watch for our next update: 1.1 - Beyond! As always, you can track our journey from the Roadmap in Vellum's main menu (quite the saga!). 

New Movement Spell - Circulate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ca28858adf34289cec867609af7f6cc8fbb060c7.gif
Go for a leisurely scroll...

Build momentum with mounting anticipation and a trusty Scroll - then zoom off into and through your foes with the first Movement Spell to have baseline damage!

What wild combos will you skillfully scrawl into existence? Use the new Pages of Power and clever strategy to show the Torn what 'doom-scrolling' really looks like!

Vignette Secrets?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8bf32d31898ec7b07274155cecb1f849ee63763f.jpg
Intrepid adventurers may have noticed some extra secrets and rewards in the various Vignettes found within the Tomes. Sometimes these hidden rewards give new Pages of Power, Temp Mana, or other useful statuses. 

I dare not speak further of such secrets - only to say that previously secret-lacking Vignettes are now up to date with something more to discover. Happy hunting!

Performance and Quality of Life
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8050a093ceadb6206fd5c597019823b10435b378.jpg
Performance and quality of life have been top of mind for us since the 1.0 launch! With today's Interlude Patch, we're taking a more ink-laden pen to performance! Many of the wild interactions between mechanics in Vellum come down to core building blocks: Projectiles, Areas of Effect, Statuses, and Augments. Improvements in this patch aim to smooth out each of these pillars' performance - both in solo and multiplayer games!

We've also made a number of networking changes and upgrades aimed at improving the stability and synchronization of your team-up scribbling adventures!

Elsewhere, in the realm of Quality of Life - we're directly addressing feedback in a few key areas: we're adding new toggles for photosensitivity and visual effect intensity, we've clarified language and tutorials in the beginning of the game and throughout the Binding/Attunement/Ascendant processes, and smoothing out other experience-impacting bugs!

Please continue to share your feedback with us as you interact with these systems!

Reward Upgrades - Book Club & Ascendant Progress
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/363701efba78a54b73b758b7f3d8e2c43f646850.jpg
The Book Club is now more rewarding! From now on, you'll be able to gain a first-time 500 Quillmark + Gilding bonus from playing new Book Club challenges - the perfect way to spice up your journey as a Scribe. Because Book Club challenges are ink-level-agnostic, tackling the Book Club right after Ascending may be a great way to kickstart your level-ups! On that topic...

Ascending is now more clear, no longer restricts Tome access, and will now allow multiple Bindings to drop at once when Over-binding Tomes! As a bonus - Ascendant Scribes also start with 500 Quillmarks to more flexibly reignite their journey!

Ascending in Vellum is designed to be an optional way to continue playing the game - we want it to be rewarding and fun, but not feel like a mandatory part of your journey. We'll continue to keep an eye on this system - let us know what you think!

Raid Tuning
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0b0224fc2ac769a90ecd012f54de11a60084051b.jpg
We're adjusting and improving many aspects of the Torn Raids - from multiplayer scaling and boss ability frequency to visual telegraphs and Codex hints. Full details are in the patch notes below, but Araxiom, The Taking Tree, Styxen, and both Torn Lords have all received adjustments.

Quillmark and Gilding rewards have also been increased to help celebrate your victories!

Epilogue
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ed9da06cc93332211e5af73045db22f8cc7fc052.jpg
Eyes on the Horizon...
1.1 - Beyond is coming soon and the Tangent Lord's curiosity knows no bounds!

In the meantime, come join us in the official Discord to share your feedback and show off your achievements, strategies, and your Reading Nooks designs (in a new dedicated channel)!

If you've been enjoying your time in Vellum, please consider leaving a review on Steam (it's a huge help, we read them all, and we always love to hear about your experiences)!

Thank you for playing Vellum - write on!

- The Vellum Team

notes.notes:
Welcome back, Scribes!

Today, we're dropping a lighter update (after two encyclopedia-sized patches in a row) - say hello to Interlude Patch: Preparations!

This update includes a New Boss Arena, New Nook Items, a couple Pages of Power, an upgrade to the Blue Signature Spell, and some bug fixes. 

Vellum's emergence from Early Access is just around the corner - we'll be sharing more information on that soon! As always, you can see how far we've come by looking at the in-game roadmap!

New Boss Arena
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/c95bc826d20b9fa937d0b46bd2855cb72c75e6c9.jpg
Deep in the forest ruins, the Torn cultivate a new foothold!

Ahh, the smell of pine trees is nostalgic, yet fresh - a perfect backdrop for climactic showdowns of Scribes and Torn!

Battles echo on crumbling stone as strange vines gnarl and twist.

Trinkets and Torchlight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/d0add9be5c5b0158733115112ecdfb8a4e3f7650.jpg
By torchlight does the quill move - bright worlds begin...

We've been playing around with our personal Reading Nooks and realized there are always more items to add!

If you're looking to lighten up your own corner of the Illuminated Library, today's the day to add a new torch or a stand for light reading. Five new items are available in Nooks!

If you have a Nook design you'd like to share - please feel free to show us! Wild designs, visual riddles, miniature platform puzzles - we'd love to see what you come up with!

A Pair of Pages, Trio of Planets, and Blue
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/42766951a67c4000342fdd837ca1537f6a1c68a4.png
Naming constellations is easy - try having a trio of planets all to yourself!

Our tried and true default generator, Jot, also gets some extra love - with Jab Jab Cross, you'll be adding +30 to the base damage of every third hit!

notes.title: Interlude Patch: In The Edit
notes.notes:
Welcome, Scribes!

We hope you've been enjoying all the cozy additions to the new Illuminated Library! Today, we're publishing Interlude Patch: In The Edit! With the sheer amount of new goodies in our previous Major Chapter - today's patch was the perfect opportunity to take a hard look at every nook and cranny of Vellum, dip into the magic ink, and come up with a myriad of improvements.

This update takes a massive step in the Performance, Balance, Reworks, Polish, and so many aspects of Vellum!

Performance, Art
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/97f8c99844526e1057e108161b5d07de42c5a5c6.jpg
We're addressing one of the Torn's greatest weapons against the Scribes - Framerate.

We've made absolutely massive strides in the performance of the game. Playing through a Tome, picking upgrades, waiting for the enemy to begin a battle, casting spells - there are thousands upon thousands of connections between the host of systems in Vellum.

Reducing the performance cost in any single item could have huge gains. 

We've reduced the cost of: Projectiles, Area Effects, Scribe Passive Stats, Torn Passive Stats, Status Effects, Pages of Power, Signature Ink core mechanics, User Interface items, Screen Effects, Fog, Lighting, every action Scribes and Torn take - oh and the small item of networking all these things.

Multiplayer Games, High Appendix Runs, Steam Decks, PCs of varying power - no matter how you enjoy the magic ink, Vellum just became that much smoother to play!

Balancing Spells and Ink
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/7af1cccf7016113be533f5e4ddb360e25da13d9c.jpg
Spells and Ink... dripping with potential!

We're buffing many spells in many ways based on feedback and the continually awesome community discussions! This also comes with some strategic redistribution of power of some spells (Eclipse) and a handful of minor (but needed) nerfs (Ghostwrite, Vault). You can read the huge amount of changes in the patch notes a the end of this blog post.

Affected Spells - Punctuate, Quip, Draw, Swoop, Passage, Blossom, Eclipse, Foreshadow, Flutterstep, Ghostwrite, Vault

Our goal with these changes is to make these spells all more competitive, while opening up their viability when combined with different signature inks (e.g. Draw)! 

On the Signature Ink front, MANY inscriptions have been rebalanced and Green Ink has been the recipient of several quality of life changes (like a hud indicator) and significant buffs.

Remastering Tomes and Pacing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/463096fae2a2a31aa889c31bc64220f542cb9899.jpg
The Scribes explore magical strengths, collecting powerful Pages - and the Torn rise to meet them...

Tomes are the battleground of our colorful conflict with the Torn! Bigger and more compelling threats invite stronger choices and more dynamic strategies.

We've refactored the way encounters happen throughout the Tomes - strangely, it's a lot of work that hopefully fades into the background! You'll see a larger variety of foes as you play and the danger ramps up - setting you and the Torn up for more dramatic, compelling, and fluctuating battles!

For new players - we're also opening up the choice to jump into Appendices from the very start! 

The Clarity of Bindings and Bosses
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ac56f3d552e8666d04878065eee437411df429b0.jpg
Deeper evils fester and brood!

Bindings have been rebalanced - we're upping the point values to give you more customization AND clarity in the ever-evolving battle with the Torn. Many Bindings now contribute much more to the Attunement goal while playing - though be warned, the Torn still grow stronger!

At the end of these newly re-organized Tomes, held together with reevaluated Bindings - who better to test your rebalanced Spells and Ink against than the Torn Bosses?

We'll be focusing (and talking) more on Bosses in the future - but In The Edit brings some fresh polish to our grand foes! There are visual and audio feedback enhancements across the board, with some behavior and cooldown adjustments thrown in - all in service of boss fights that put your Scribe skills to the ultimate test (while being clear, fair, balanced, and satisfying). 

The Polish of Pages - and All Other Things!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/1855658b811bfe1fe9874ff28bedfaa6244b0bb1.jpg
Details on details on details...

This interlude patch includes so much additional detail - Chapter endings, UI sound effects, fanfare, feedback, and so on! One of the most noticeable changes will be Pages of Power, now much more clearly identifiable in their grandeur!

Magical Pages will now be appropriately decorated as Storied, Renowned, Epic, Legendary, or Unique (if you're lucky enough to read one)!

If any details stand out as your favorite or you have feedback to share with us, please do! So much of this update was driven by feedback; it is truly helpful to us.

Epilogue - One Big Library
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/49f6ec2addd14be460062522516bce050963140e.jpg
Interlude Patch: In The Edit also brings a handful of new Nook items - and introduces the community-requested ability to place items under tables (push in your chair, create your own dioramas, get creative)!

This update went through a fluid process with a lot of builds going on the testing branch. Hunting bugs, giving suggestions, breaking things in brand new ways - thank you everyone who tested In The Edit ahead of time! 

As we look to the horizon, Vellum's full launch is drawing closer - and you can definitely expect it to be a rather large update! In preparation for 1.0, we'll be targeting smaller, Interlude Patch-sized updates (a truly hilarious thing to say in this particular blog post - yes) that will allow us to stay responsive to feedback, squeeze in some cool extra stuff, and keep focused on the next verse of this saga!

Thank you for playing Vellum - go read a book!

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Feast
notes.notes:
Welcome, Scribes!

We've loved all the feedback and discussion after Chapter VIII: Hard Cover and the addition of the Teal Signature Ink! We continue to gather feedback and have been working on making improvements, with the next step being today's Interlude Patch: Feast. 

On today's menu: some community requests in the form of Page Omission, dramatically improved enemy Hit Reactions, and major strides in Game Performance! We've also continued to expand content to add variety to your adventures with new Vignettes and Player Pages.

As always, you can check the in-game roadmap to see what's coming up. But for now, let's jump into the additions!

Performance Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/d65ba51fbd40a91484a9aafb22345e52ee11b323.jpg
Like the Scribes and Torn - Performance is an evolving battle. Little wins here and there get pushed back by crazier combos and new features. Interlude Patch: Feast makes huge strides in winning back framerate with two major areas. 

The first is a new way of handling game actions (projectiles, explosions, arrow rains, etc.) by re-using old copies so we don't need to create or destroy effects each time they're used. This should give a sizable performance boost, particularly later in Tomes within the Appendices when hundreds of effects are happening every second.

The second big improvement is in how we handle the Torn and their stats and behavior. With some aggressive data caching, multi-threaded logic, and more optimized code flow - we've seen huge performance gains when there are many enemies on the battlefield.

While there is still plenty of room for improvement, these two major performance overhauls have increased performance in general combat by a significant degree. And in late game runs, we've easily seen 100x improvements, going from 'seconds-per-frame' to 60fps in many cases! 

New Vignettes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/863bc3fb1d134391e5d2d94620b7327c9e4c879b.jpg
Deep within the Tomes, Scribes can find themselves in three new Vignettes! Scale the fungal depths of Mycellum Quarry, take in the view in Overlook, and dance with Radiance.

New Lore pages have appeared in the Vignettes of Pride and Profit, further detailing the paths of Myriad, Verse, and Horizon.

Hit Reactions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2f008d7b5eca9e6bd197b5aa8fa59e7f6e966030.jpg
Another element of feedback we've seen echoed a number of times is wanting more feedback when you deal damage to the Torn.

This update adds two new interactions - Damage Animations and Hit Flash. Now, Torn will physically react to the damage they take, giving better feedback and making damage feel more impactful. Additionally, Torn you damage will flash the color of your Signature Ink, for some visible, thematic interaction.

If you find the Hit Flash distracting, you can disable it in the General Settings menu!

Pages of Power
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/06a4f33165d8edd7a0f065ff070edf13c07c6636.jpg
This update expands the Codex with over 20 new Pages of Power to help you push back the Torn! This time, we're focusing on build expansion and collaboration, with new interactions between your spells, as well as a bunch of new multiplayer Ink Combinations (for example: your Orange Atlas might apply Blot if a Blue Scribe is standing nearby)!

Page Omission
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/f4eea5a07fbffe3c68a10223f3a8200e5939c51d.jpg
Sometimes, you might pick up a page that doesn't quite cooperate with your build - now you can do something about it! By popular request, we've added the ability to Remove Pages of Power you pick up during your run - just hold right click on the page in the Tab menu, and you can Omit it from your book!

There might be a couple of odd interactions that need ironing out (omitting pages that give you stacking stats doesn't remove what you've already built up, etc.) - but we'll resolve them as we go, and we definitely think it's better to have the feature with a few quirks than not at all!

Epilogue
Interlude Patch: Feast also brings a smattering of bug fixes, adjustments, and some light tuning! We called this update 'Feast' for a few  reasons: to allude to the sheer amount of stuff, the Thanksgiving holiday, but more importantly - the communal nature of this update!

In each post here, we make a point to write out how thankful we are for the enthusiasm and generosity of our players. Today's patch truly embodies the joy of our Early Access process; nearly every aspect of Feast has been directly influenced by feedback and discussions in the community.

For those who celebrate it, have a superb Thanksgiving!
For everybody, thank you for making Vellum better with us!
- The Vellum Team

"Happy Wednesday, Scribes! Vellum Early Access continues the adventure with Interlude Patch: Initiative!"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/e907722b7da7723064f0ba95ad69f85b79625081.gif

Roll to attack with Clatter: a new generator spell that conjures a 20-sided die, then blasts it at your foes!

Clatter applies additional effects determined by the result of your conjured d20. These payloads vary from an explosive area burst generating extra mana at higher numbers to a gut-wrenching single point of damage when rolling a 1.

We're releasing a patch today to adjust issues and address feedback relating to difficulty. There are also fixes and enhancements to the recent Chapter III: Revelry & Respite update!

Overcoming satisfying hurdles is at the heart of Vellum; Scribes direct the hunger of their foes, apply dangerous Bindings to Tomes, and venture into the depth of the Appendices - all in a quest to battle and defeat the Torn. 

In service of challenge that is consistently satisfying, we're making significant adjustments to Vellum's difficulty.

Today's patch adjusts how Vellum scales enemies across the board (Chapters, Bindings, Appendices). First off, we've fixed an important bug that had previously undercut the scaling factor of Bindings - so our intended difficulty curve had been 'leaking' a portion of its potency.

To combine with Bindings, we're substantially increasing the starting health values of Torn - with a small bump to their per-Chapter scaling. We're also adjusting the timing for Barrier regeneration for both Scribes and Torn to take slightly longer - giving more weight to Barrier-related powers and gameplay. We want a much more dangerous - but satisfying - iteration of the Torn:

Our goal is for difficulty to be a better partner for player power - keeping focus on the best dynamic relationships of the game.

This is an impactful step toward balancing the game, but it isn't the last step. We're eager to hear your feedback when playing with these changes and examining where Vellum's challenges find their brightest spots.

Thank you for playing!

- The Vellum Team

Interlude Patch: Till Death
Good day, Scribes - we hope you've been braving the seasons and studying up on your Inks since our last Chapter! We've heard a lot of excitement for Pink - thank you for your enthusiasm! Today, we're rolling out our newest Interlude Patch: Till Death!

This patch addresses community feedback on death, danger, performance, Bonus Objectives, and balance! We also introduce a tiny new Boss we found. Let's take a look at the patch! (And, as always, you can check out the roadmap in-game to track our progress - and see what's next!)

Revisiting Danger and Death
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0e329f1014586d7ce5916242c7deee77283dca8d.png
We love high-stakes windows in games; skill, luck, instinct, preparation - you meet the challenge with everything you've got! Victory or defeat, you face your moment of truth head-on.

In Till Death, we're making targeted changes to improve these moments. Previously, these high-stakes windows came and went too quickly without us knowing we were in them. That makes it hard for players to excel in the spotlight - to come out with a clear and earned victory or satisfying and fair defeat. The goal: You must FEEL when the stakes are high and BELIEVE you can affect them.

Our major changes: One-Shot Protection, Last Stand Removal (Solo), Last Stand Rework (Multiplayer)

One-Shot Protection - High danger hits are more likely to leave you at low health, allowing for players to react and take more dramatic advantage of moment-to-moment strategy and long-term build-making. This affects all Scribes (any levels, solo and multiplayer) and will not prevent death from intentional "Annihilation-level" events.

Last Stand Removal (Solo) - We want the "fight for your life!" drama to happen in the naturally occurring dire moments carved out by One-Shot Protection and your defensives/builds. Ink Level revives still function and have new places in the Ink Level unlock order.

Last Stand Rework (Multiplayer) - Reviving other players functions similarly to the current behavior. Downed Scribes may now choose to activate their Ink Level revives or keep fighting to fill up their revive bar. This bar is still capped and requires a teammate to stand nearby to finish the process. All downed Scribes now use a ranged Ink Torrent spell to damage foes from any range and stay engaged with the game around them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/54c7d3ebae6cd1edf9e1ad747122289f21139135.png

Splice Boss - "Big" Cap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/3cabad2309d1e25f075fefa2022960666a543ae5.png
We've foraged for a new Boss to add to the Torn roster: "Big" Cap! This fun little guy is just a cute and cuddly Splice Boss. 

It's probably best to let him plant all the mushrooms he wants...

Pages of Power, Balance & Tuning, and Bonus Objectives
We keep expanding the Codex! Till Death (as always) brings new Pages of Power - including an avenue for some Generator-centric builds!

We've also spent some time tuning Blue, not only with some new pages and adjustments, but a buff to the Spread keyword! Blue's ability to tackle larger threats should be enhanced, while still keeping value on multi-dotting.

Bonus Objectives have all been tweaked! Based on some player feedback and a couple pieces of new tech, we've taken a light touch to nearly every Bonus Objective. Notably, we've also taken a performance pass to help clean up some wild and unwieldy combos (or strange occurrences with ally/foes tags getting confused). 

Thank you for playing Vellum and sharing your thoughts with us!
- The Vellum Team
